name: Zuniceratops
sum: Zuniceratops is a small, brow-horned ceratopsian from the Turonian Moreno Hill Formation of New Mexico.
wsnote: Ranges in the cited Wikipedia revision; basal skull length up to 40 cm.
holotype: MSM P2101, a juvenile or subadult specimen — Moreno Hill Formation, Zuni Basin, New Mexico.
material: One skull and bones of several individuals; adults include MSM P2102 and MSM P3812.
biology: Skull long and low with no nasal horn but well-developed brow horns; the bonebed has been used as evidence for grouping behaviour in ceratopsians.
author: Wolfe and Kirkland 1998
